rows.title: Long Product Sync (2.5 mins)
rows.hypothesis: Haan toh basically kal ka jo project sync tha usmein humne thoda sa discuss kiya ki app ka current status kya hai aur next week tak humein exactly kya complete karna hai. Abhi back end ka major part almost done hai. But transcription pipeline mein thoda latency issue aa raha hai. Kabhi kabhi audio upload karne ke baad transcript aane mein 30-40 seconds lag rahe hain. which is okay for a prototype but production mein itna delay nahi hona chahiye. Rohit ne bola ki woh aaj evening tak check karega ki processing ko background job mein shift kar sakte hain ya nahi. Agar woh possible hai toh user ko ek loading state dikha denge instead of making them wait on the same screen. Maine bola ki haan yeh better approach hai. Front End Site pe Neha ko Summary aur Action Items ka UI Finalize karna hai. Abhi Cards thode Basic hain toh Ideally Summary ek Separate Section mein ho aur Action Items Checkbox ke saath dikhein. Important yeh hai ki agar Action Item mein Deadline ya kisi pasand ka naam Mention ho toh woh bhi Extract ho jaye. For example Friday client email output owner amit task client email due date Friday. Ek aur cheez. Humein English ke liye tasting aur karni padegi because kuch recordings mein English aur Hindi. Sentence ke beech mein switching kaafi frequent hai. Maine do sample recordings already share kar di hain. but Priya ko aur at least 5 recordings collect karke deni hai preferably different accents or different speaking speeds ke saath marketing wala part abhi hold pe rakho because product flow stable hone ke baad high landing page copy finalize karna useful hoga so immediate priority back-end latency action item extraction aur front-end UI hai aaj ke end tak Rohit latency ka update dega Neha latest UI screen shot share karegi aur Priya testing ke liye additional recordings upload karegi main meanwhile extraction prompt ko improve karunga aur specifically dates, names aur tasks ko structured format mein nikalne ki koshish karunga. aur haan kal subah 11 baje ek short 15 minute sync rakh lete hain usmein bas blockers discuss karenge koi long meeting nahi agar sab green hai toh directly implementation continue karenge
rows.title_out: Project Sync Update and Next Steps
rows.summary: The project sync discussed the current app status and next week's goals. The backend is mostly complete, but the transcription pipeline has latency issues. Frontend UI for summary and action items needs finalization, and more English testing is required. Marketing is on hold until the product flow is stable.

action_items.task: Check if processing can be shifted to a background job to reduce latency.
Finalize the UI for Summary and Action Items, ensuring summary is a separate section and action items have checkboxes.
Collect and provide at least 5 additional English recordings for testing, preferably with different accents or speaking speeds.
Provide an update on the latency issue.
Share the latest UI screenshots.
Upload additional recordings for testing.
Improve the extraction prompt to specifically extract dates, names, and tasks in a structured format.
Hold a short 15-minute sync to discuss blockers.
